entries.title: Demo loads reliably
items: The demo now opens as soon as it's ready, instead of getting stuck on the welcome screen.

entries.title: The guided demo is live
items: Play a whole game of Palermo Noir in your browser, alone at a table of bots, with nothing to install and no account.
Pick one of the 14 roles or Surprise me, a table of 6, 8 or 10, English or Greek, and the short demo (about six minutes) or a full game (about fifteen).
A guide stops the game at each new moment to show you what to tap, and why; Chapters, Back, 2× speed and Behind the scenes help you follow it.
